categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet-labeled PR modifying wallet descriptor import routines in src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Resolves long-standing user request #27336 by allowing descriptors to be imported without re-supplying private keys over RPC when the wallet already holds them. As noted in the description, 'importing a descriptor to a wallet that has private keys requires the descriptor to include the private keys', unnecessarily forcing users to handle and expose raw private key material.
